verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents a dedicated sandbox environment with test cards and ACH accounts that produce deterministic approved or declined outcomes. Its marketing claims "full end-to-end sandbox testing," and the going-live docs describe phased integration ahead of production. The isolation from production is implied by the separate sandbox environment rather than spelled out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/production data and credential separation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
